title: Adaptive Richards retry-ceiling diagnosis
central_question: Is the remaining realistic-workload Reference failure caused only by the frozen eight-retry ceiling, or by a genuine solver/minimum-step floor?

authority.observed_failure: RNP02 retry budget on B02/B05/B06/B11/B12; B16 complete

decision_rule.qualify_R12: R12 completes all six materials and both histories with hard mass gate preserved.
decision_rule.qualify_R16: Only if R12 fails at least one material and R16 completes all six; record R12 failures explicitly.
decision_rule.genuine_floor: R16 still fails at least one material, or minimum-step/domain failure appears before retry exhaustion.

candidate_firewall: No S4 candidate evidence used for retry-ceiling selection.
